```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(itsmr)
```

## Load data

```{r}
dow <- read.csv("dow.csv", header = TRUE)
head(dow)
```

## a) Time Series Plot
```{r} 
# Convert to R date in order to use seq properly
dow$Date <- as.Date(dow$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")

quarterly_ticks <- seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), max(dow$Date), by = "3 months")
jan_ticks <- seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), as.Date("2015-01-01"), by = "1 year")
yearly_ticks <- c(jan_ticks, as.Date("2015-12-31"))
yearly_labels <- c("2010", "2011", "2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")

add_axis <- function() {
  axis(1, at = yearly_ticks, labels = yearly_labels, cex.axis = 0.8)
  axis(1, at = quarterly_ticks, labels = FALSE, tck = -0.01)
}

plot(dow$Date, dow$Close, 
     type = "l", 
     col = "blue", 
     xaxt = "n",
     main = "Dow Jones Industrial Average (2010 - 2016)",
     xlab = "Month and Year",
     ylab = "Average Price")

add_axis()
```
**<comment on any apparent trend here>**

## b) Linear Trend Fit
```{r}
lin_trend <- trend(dow$Close, p = 1) # Linear Trend
lin_resid  <- dow$Close - lin_trend
```

```{r}
# Time series with quadratic trend
plot(dow$Date, dow$Close, type = "l", col = "blue", xaxt = "n",
     main = "DOW Close with Linear Trend",
     xlab = "Month and Year", ylab = "Closing Price")
lines(dow$Date, lin_trend, col = "red", lwd = 2)
add_axis()
legend("topleft", legend = c("Original", "Linear trend"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = c(1, 2))
```
**<comment on if residuals appear to be a WN process>**

## c) Sample ACF and Linear Regression Coefficient
```{r}
lin_resid_acf <- acf(lin_resid, na.action = na.pass,
    main = "ACF of Linear Residuals on Close Price")
```
```{r}
r <- lin_resid # For consistency with the formula in the question
n <- length(r)
r_t   <- r[2:n] # Start at t = 2
r_t1 <- r[1:(n-1)]

model <- lm(r_t ~ r_t1 - 1) # - 1 will remove the intercept term

summary(model)
```
The estimated coefficient phi_hat is: 
```{r}
phi_hat <- coef(model)["r_t1"]
print(phi_hat)
```

```{r}
plot(r_t1, r_t,
     xlab = expression(r[t-1]), 
     ylab = expression(r[t]),
     main = expression(paste("Scatterplot of Residuals ", r[t], " vs ", r[t-1])),
     pch = 19, 
     col = "darkgray")

abline(model, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0, v = 0, lty = 2, col = "lightgray")
```

```{r}
lin_resid_acf <- acf(lin_resid, na.action = na.pass,
               main = "Sample ACF vs. Theoretical AR(1) on Close Price",
               col = "darkgray", lwd = 2)

lags <- drop(lin_resid_acf$lag)
theoretical_acf <- phi_hat^lags

lines(lags, theoretical_acf, 
      type = "b",
      col = "blue", 
      pch = 19,
      lwd = 2)

legend("topright", 
       legend = c("Sample ACF", paste0("Theoretical AR(1) (phi = ", round(phi_hat, 4), ")")),
       col = c("darkgray", "blue"), 
       lty = 1, 
       lwd = 2, 
       pch = c(NA, 19))
```

```{r}
acf_original <- acf(lin_resid, na.action = na.pass, plot = FALSE)
acf_ar1      <- acf(residuals(model), na.action = na.pass, plot = FALSE)

# Extract flat vectors
lags <- drop(acf_original$lag)
val_original <- drop(acf_original$acf)
val_ar1      <- drop(acf_ar1$acf)

# Plot the original residuals
plot(lags, val_original, 
     type = "h",
     col = "darkgray", 
     lwd = 1.5,
     ylim = c(min(c(val_original, val_ar1, -0.2)), 1), # Adjust ylim to how big residuals are
     xlab = "Lag", 
     ylab = "ACF",
     main = "ACF Comparison: Original vs. AR(1) Model Residuals")

# Add squares at the top of the original ACF bars
points(lags, val_original, 
       pch = 15,
       col = "darkgray", 
       cex = 1.2)

# Overlay the AR(1) model residual bars
lines(lags, val_ar1, 
      type = "h", 
      col = "blue", 
      lwd = 3)

# Add circles at the top of the AR(1) ACF bars
points(lags, val_ar1, 
       pch = 19,
       col = "blue", 
       cex = 1.2)

# Add the x-axis
abline(h = 0, lty = 1, col = "black")

legend("topright", 
       legend = c("Original Residuals (Squares)", "AR(1) Model Residuals (Circles)"),
       col = c("darkgray", "blue"), 
       lty = 1, 
       lwd = c(3, 3), 
       pch = c(19, 19))
```

**<Comment on how well the estimated AR(1) process matches the residuals.>**
